items.title: 61539_Butter Jackson oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] There was a prizefighter, Jack White or somebody, that used to be in there, was it? [INTERVIEWEE] A prizefighter? Jack Johnson.

ctx.x: It stayed there for a long time. About 130 -- maybe 140th Street. Between 140th and 39th, around in there.
There was a prizefighter, Jack White or somebody, that used to be in there, was it?
